Modern steel silos to reduce wastage.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Modern steel silos are being adopted to minimize storage and transit wastage of food grains.
Digitization is applied across the supply chain to ensure transparency and track distribution.
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) is being tested experimentally to streamline subsidy delivery.
Decentralized procurement models are encouraged to facilitate state-level management and efficiency.
Focus on the rationale behind replacing traditional godowns with modern steel silos (wastage reduction).
Understand the policy transition from centralized to decentralized procurement in agricultural markets.
Identify the key technology interventions (DBT and supply chain digitization) commonly asked in economic reform questions.
